project_type: WordPress Elementor plugin + static HTML section pages for a Persian digital agency (Vira SEO)
build_system: No build system - static HTML files and PHP plugin files. PHP lint for syntax checking.
test_framework: No automated tests - manual visual review + PHP syntax lint
verification_instructions: 1. Check all HTML files open correctly and are valid HTML. 2. Verify PHP files for syntax correctness using pattern matching (no php binary available). 3. Verify all 9 homepage section HTML files exist and follow the pattern of existing pages. 4. Verify class-presets.php includes homepage data for all relevant widgets. 5. Check all widget PHP files for structural consistency.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - direct file editing
environment_constraints: No PHP binary available in sandbox. No WordPress/Elementor environment for live testing. Validation limited to file structure verification and grep-based pattern checks.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: RTL Persian content, Vazirmatn font, brand color palette (#170C79, #128BE0, #8ACBD0, #EFE3CA, #060832). Each section file is self-contained with inline <style> and <script>.
key_patterns: 1. Each page has a sections/ directory with numbered HTML files (01-hero.html etc). 2. A preview-all-sections.html combines all sections. 3. Section HTML files use inline styles with CSS custom properties. 4. Plugin presets in class-presets.php use static methods named get_{widget_name}_presets() returning arrays keyed by page slug. 5. $page_labels, $widget_pages, and $palettes arrays must be updated for new pages. 6. All widgets use the Vira_Sections_Preset_Trait.
directory_structure: Root contains page directories (sections/, seo-google/, seo-training-tabriz/, app-android-tabriz/) each with sections/ sub-folder and preview HTML. vira-sections-plugin/ contains the Elementor plugin with widgets/, includes/, assets/, and docs/.
